name: context overview
wording: an account of one bounded context computed from the concept journal and the ledger, never written by hand: its subject and place in the context map, then its concepts as plain prose, whole before parts: the concepts no other is built from first, in the order recorded, and every other concept after the first concept shown that is built from it, while concepts reached only through a cycle follow in the order recorded with the cycle named, then its open decisions and the cuts in flight on it; it is read first at every reconstitution, so a session meets the design as one whole before its parts.
reason: The illustrator's boundary on the reconstitution cut: the order did not settle several roots or a cycle of concepts built from each other.
